O.outcome_detail: students' time to complete minimally invasive mitral valve techniques

cells.quote: Students’ mean time to completion improved from an initial 54 (SD 5) minutes to a final 35 (SD 6) minutes (p < 0.05), and residents’ mean time improved from an initial 47 (SD 6) minutes to a final 31 (SD 6) minutes (p < 0.05).
cells.note: The systematic review reports a pre-post comparison in 10 students and 10 residents; the study text does not state learners' prior expertise or ages.
